description: Signed inside the detector by a manufacturer-certified hardware key, during a physical exposure.
Manufacturer-certified, but the key is held in software, so anyone with the key file can sign.
Signed by the detector's hardware key, but the detector reported a test pattern.
A valid signature from a key generated for the purpose, which chains to no manufacturer.
No signature at all, like almost every file recorded to date.
The genuine frame with one pixel value changed after signing.
The genuine frame with its wavelength edited after signing; the pixels are unchanged.
